implement.summary: Defect on BASE_SHA (VERIFIED by reading + by the new test failing 7/10 on base): supabase/functions/api/index.ts carried its own copy of the rank definition instead of computing through packages/shared-types/src/scoringDefinition.ts — a literal tier ladder PLAYER_RANK_TIERS (index.ts:2714-2720 on base), a local playerRankTierForRating (2722-2728), a hand-rolled technique sort `b.score - a.score || (a.shot_type < b.shot_type ? -1 : 1)` (2792), and the inline-fallback rating with literal cap 5 and 100 hundredths (2831-2843). Neither GET /v1/rank (payload 2853-2862) nor GET /v1/progress (2700) emitted a definitionVersion, so a response could not identify which definition produced it. Fix: new supabase/functions/api/scoringDefinition.ts re-exports SCORING_DEFINITION / SCORING_DEFINITION_VERSION from the shared module (same object by reference, not a copy) and derives PLAYER_RANK_TIERS, RANK_CONFIDENCE_CAP, RANK_HUNDREDTHS_PER_POINT, RANK_RATING_DECIMALS, playerRankTierForRating, compareTechniqueOrder (walks rating.techniqueOrder.keys, code-unit collation) and ratingFromTechniques (confidence-weighted mean of rounded technique scores in integer hundredths, the same expression as computePlayerRank; null when no rows). index.ts now imports those (the import sits under the preserved tier-threshold comment; existing comments were left verbatim), sorts techniques with compareTechniqueOrder, computes the inline fallback via ratingFromTechniques + playerRankTierForRating, and tags rank.definitionVersion and progress.definitionVersion with SCORING_DEFINITION_VERSION. Saved-state precedence, { rank: null } for no scored evidence, auth, rate limits, 60s cache TTL, cache fence/invalidation and generic 5xx bodies are unchanged. Commits: ea7bcaeb (test only, fails on base) then 59a4afbe (module + wiring + tightened constant pins). The regression test drives the real handler through routesHarness for every golden case in both saved-state and inline-fallback modes (rating, tier, techniqueCount, technique rows, definitionVersion), every unranked case ({ rank: null }, no version), progress version tagging, technique ordering, module identity/derived constants, the 10^decimals == perPoint rounding invariant, and a static pin that index.ts imports ./scoringDefinition.ts and carries no minRating / Math.min(...,5) literals.
